title: Grateful Dead Live at Taft Auditorium on 1971-10-30
source: Recording of the FM Broadcast on WEBN Cincinnati, DAT provided and transferred by Stuccoholmes, Editing and Mastering by Jamie Waddell in Wavelab 7.1, Critical Listening assitance by John Wenzel. Track, FLAC and Pack by Norm

ai_review.summary: Energetic Halloween show highlighted by a transcendent "Comes A Time" and solid overall sound despite no detailed recording notes.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its high‑energy vibe, crazy Halloween crowd and memorable moments like Jerry Garcia’s pedal‑steel cameo with the New Riders. Reviewers single out "Comes A Time" as a favorite, noting emotional vocals and superb playing. While no specific technical details are given, the positive feedback suggests the recording is at least good enough to enjoy the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars) and highlight both the musical performance and overall enjoyment; lack of technical detail prevents a perfect score but the show quality drives a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on sound clarity, mix or source type, only expressing general satisfaction with the listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Halloween atmosphere with a decked‑out audience; New Riders opened with Jerry on pedal steel before the Dead took over, creating a seamless and memorable flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for emotional vocals on "Comes A Time" and his pedal‑steel performance with the New Riders.
